descriptionChirho: A large body of water, whether the Mediterranean, the Red Sea, the Dead Sea, or seas in general; includes singular and plural, with all prepositional and pronominal forms retaining the literal aquatic meaning.
The noun in construct state forming part of a geographic proper name (Sea of Chinnereth, Sea of the Arabah, Sea of Reeds, etc.), functioning as the nomen regens before a place designation.
Directional sense derived from the Mediterranean Sea lying to Israel's west; used absolutely or with directional he (yammah) to indicate the western compass direction or movement toward the west.
